function.name: get_gvar_def
function.description: Retrieve the definition of a global variable whose type is a struct, including its line numbers, from the specified source file (.c or .h). The gvar_name must be related to src_file: it must be defined, declared, referenced, or used in the specified file. Do not query unrelated global variables.

gvar_name.description: The name of the target global variable. It must appear in or be referenced by src_file.

src_file.description: The source file where gvar_name is defined, declared, referenced, or used.
